name: 月間の気分記録
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: LH13-0006「月間の気分記録」, one Japanese December mood-calendar card.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: Image 1 ORIGINAL Calm monthly screen controls calendar state, date positions, recorded versus future cells, emoji/artwork geometry, proportions, alignment and fine details. Image 2 FigCraft mock is SECONDARY for Japanese content/typography, and has inaccuracies: all 31 dates get mint circles; original record colors and selected/current ring are missing; face crops have dark square backgrounds. Do not reproduce those errors. Images 3 and 4 are original relaxed and stressed emoji crops: preserve artwork, remove only the dark background. Image 5 is approved Lighthouse bus STYLE ONLY for white rounded surface, neutral border and restrained soft shadow.
Primary request: render ONE compact Japanese calendar card, pure white canvas, white rounded surface, subtle neutral outline and soft downward shadow. Match the original's exact month grid with 7 columns and 5 weeks. Centered month「12月」above weekday header「月」「火」「水」「木」「金」「土」「日」. Dates:
row1 1 2 3 4 5 6 7
row2 8 9 10 11 12 13 14
row3 15 16 17 18 19 20 21
row4 22 23 24 25 26 27 28
row5 29 30 31 (remaining cells blank).
Date numbers beneath each day's circular mood position; all 31 dates once only.
STATE from ORIGINAL: days 1–18 and 20 are empty neutral outline circles with white centers. Day19 alone has the original relaxed emoji (closed eyes, peaceful smile) on a small blue mood badge. Day21 alone has original stressed emoji (squeezed eyes, crease brows, small open mouth) on a small coral/pink badge and a distinct thin outer selected/current ring. Preserve this current/selected outline in forest green #1F6444 so it is visible on white, not a filled green circle. Dates22–31 are FUTURE dates: date numbers only in their proper rows, no mood circles/emoji/placeholder badges. Never add additional recorded days.
Accent decision: original blue19 and coral21 denote different recorded moods, keep this meaningful mapping in the two small badges only. White empty circles with fine neutral border; no mint grid or broad tint. Preserve original emoji color/details; remove dark square remnants without substitution. No legend or extra summary.
Typography locked: Meiryo Regular month14/24, weekday/date12/16, tracking0, dark ink #1D1D1D with quiet gray weekday labels. No oversized bold month. No arrows, plus, close/list control, title outside this component, buttons, charts, metrics or extra text. Logical 390x425 proportion, balanced column spacing, full card and all dates visible without clipping. No device frame, watermarks, gloss or glow. Raster candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画月間画面・表情クロップ・日本語モックを実見。原画を状態/日付位置/図像/細部の主参照とし、モックの全31日ミント円と色/リング欠落を補正。生成結果実見:12月、月始まり、1-31が1回ずつ、19金曜に青の落ち着いた表情、21日曜にコーラルの張りつめた表情と緑外輪、22-31は数字のみ、白面と空セルを確認。意味色は2記録のみ。厳密な原画図像ピクセルとMeiryo実体は未証明。reviewedは画像候補のエージェント視覚レビューで所有者承認/編集性/実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
